content:
Overview

Narva is a city in Ida-Viru County with a population of 56,680. Estonia’s easternmost city on the Russian border, dominated by the impressive Hermann Castle facing the Russian Ivangorod Fortress across the Narva River. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
